title: Great tour with parents and teen kids
text: Natalia was an amazing guide. Long-ish tour and she managed to keep us engaged, together, and moving. Thank you!
author: Jennifer_K

title: Sandra, our guide was...
text: Sandra, our guide was excellent! She made the history come to life. La Alhambra is an amazing place to see.
author: Sheilakwilliamson

title: Relaxed walk
text: A very nice walk through the Alhambra and the palaces. A lot of information that was conveyed entertainingly.
author: Andreas_B

title: Great tour La Alhambra
text: We had a really nice and knowledgeable tour guide, Natasha Nieves. She really knows her stuff about the Alhambra and the Generalife. The castle tour at the end was awesome too. Really great views of the entire area. Overall, I would rate it as the top tour I had in Spain.
author: aldogD4535UY

title: Alhambra and Granada
text: Nasrid Palace, our guides isabella and guida.  They were very accommodating with our questions and pictures
author: Manzer_H

title: Very nice guided tour in Generalife and Alhambra gardens and palaces
text: Very nice guided tour in Generalife and Alhambra at a quiet pace. Nice views, interesting information and wonderfull stories told by our guide.
author: 482kris

title: Interesting and well planned.
text: Natasha made the tours interesting and detailed while staying very attentive to our group and our questions. She was very skilled with language, and her English was excellent. The listening aids really made the tour feel immersive.
author: CLAUDIO_G

title: Highly recommended
text: This was my birthday present this year so needed to be a good experience. Our guide Ana was perfect - very pleasant, professional and knowledgable. We were a small group of 9on the tour. My husband and I throughly enjoyed the day and would recommend the tour and Ana our guide very highly.
author: Phil_U

title: Wonderful gardens and...
text: Wonderful gardens and architecture. The guide was excellent and provided many facts and brought the history to life
author: Kim_C

title: The Alhambra Granada.
text:
Our guide was more than exceptional. His passion and love for 
The Alhambra was contagious. His explanations were presented in such an interesting way. 
The Alhambra is an amazing piece of history brought to life by an amazing  guide  Jorge Carrillo Vázquez.
author: Fionbarr_M
